settings.terms_content:
Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using Attendix App . By accessing or using the Application, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you disagree with any part of the Terms, you may not access the Application.
1. Account Security
•	To use this Application, you must be an employee of a company that is a registered client with us.
•	You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your company's code and your personal login credentials.
•	You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account or any other breach of security.
2. Use of the Application
•	The Application is intended to record employee check-in and check-out times using GPS location, camera, and fingerprint recognition technologies to ensure accuracy and accountability.
•	You agree to the use of this data for the sole purpose of verifying your location and identity during work hours.
•	The Application is committed to collecting only the minimum data necessary to achieve this purpose.
3. User Conduct
•	You agree to use the Application only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of others.
•	Any attempt to breach the Application's security, tamper with location data, or manipulate the attendance process is strictly prohibited.
4. Modifications to the Service
•	We reserve the right to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, any part of the Application with or without notice.
5. Intellectual Property
•	All rights, content, and designs within the Application are the exclusive property of the Company and may not be copied or reused without written permission.
settings.privacy_content:
[Attendix]  is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use Attendix App.
1. Information We Collect
To provide you with our services effectively, we may collect the following types of information:
•	Account Information: Your company code, employee ID, and name.
•	Geolocation Data (GPS): We collect your GPS location at the exact moment you check in or check out to verify you are at your authorized work location. Your location is not tracked outside of these check-in/out moments.
•	Photographs: We may require you to take a photo when checking in or out to confirm your identity.
•	Biometric Data (Fingerprint): We may use your fingerprint to authenticate your identity and ensure that the attendance record is being made by you personally. Please be aware that your fingerprint data is either processed securely on your own device (using its built-in biometric authentication) or stored in a highly encrypted format on our servers and is never used for any other purpose.
2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information for the following purposes:
•	To accurately record your attendance.
•	To verify your identity.
•	To ensure compliance with your employer's policies.
•	To improve and maintain the Application's performance.
•	To comply with legal obligations.
3. Sharing Your Information
•	With Your Employer: Attendance logs, along with associated location data, will be shared with your employer (the company you work for) for employee management purposes.
•	With Third Parties: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes. We may share your data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating the Application (e.g., server hosting), provided they agree to uphold the same standards of confidentiality.
•	For Legal Compliance: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or to protect our rights and safety.
4. Data Security
We take the security of your data seriously. We employ strict technical and administrative security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. All sensitive data is encrypted during transmission and storage.
5. Your Rights
You have the right to:
•	Access the personal data we hold about you.
•	Request correction of any inaccurate data.
•	Request deletion of your data (understanding that this may affect your employer's ability to document your attendance).
•	Object to the processing of your data.
6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
7. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
•	Email: abdallhghareeb2019@gmail.com
•	Address: Egypt - cairo
settings.about_us_content:
Welcome to [Attendix] , the reliable and smart solution for employee attendance management.
We are a team of passionate developers and HR experts dedicated to providing businesses with an accurate and easy-to-use tool for tracking employee work hours with efficiency and complete transparency. We believe that time management is the key to success for any organization, which is why we developed our application to combine the latest technology with the highest security standards.
Through our application, we aim to:
•	Simplify the Process: Make checking in and out quick and effortless, whether from the office or the field.
•	Increase Accuracy: Utilize GPS location, camera, and biometric authentication to ensure data integrity and prevent fraud.
•	Build Trust: Foster a bridge of trust between management and employees through a clear and transparent system for everyone.
We are here to support you every step of the way. We always welcome your inquiries and suggestions at [abdallhghareeb2019@gmail.com].
Towards smarter and more effective management.
The [Attendix] Team
